reason: I already have a drawer full of half-used bottles and $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli, which last me longer. The sachets are handy for travel, but not enough to pay more on my budget.
objection: $29.99 for one month of magnesium is too much when I make $23k a year and can get a bigger bottle for less.
would_change_my_mind: A price under about $20 for the 30 days, or a cheap 7-day trial pack I could throw in my bag to see if I actually use it.
